description: This PHP source file defines the LoginService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for logging user login activities and handling login logs, including user credential-based login and OAuth2/OIDC login logging.

classes.name: LoginService
classes.description: Service class handling user login logging activities, including adding login logs based on user credentials or OAuth2/OIDC logins.

methods.name: getLoginLogDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of LoginLogDao used to access login log data.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Creates a login log entry for a user based on given user credentials.

methods.name: addOIDCLogin
methods.description: Creates a login log entry for a user authenticated via OIDC/OAuth2.
